title: Synthetic search quality and joint5 compilation sweep

source.title: Part C. Math and scaling laws

method.prerequisites_and_exclusions: n/4 each, as reported in the summary
method.compilation: Optimization level 3, seed 11, cz/rz/sx/x basis, heavy-hex coupling map
method.mps: Reported sweep of bond dimensions up to 128; n = 32 and 40 used 4, 16, 64

metrics.ordinary_native_2q_mean: Rounded seed-averaged routed native two-qubit gate count
metrics.joint5_native_2q_mean: Rounded seed-averaged routed native two-qubit gate count
metrics.derived_gate_change_percent: 100 * (joint5_native_2q_mean - ordinary_native_2q_mean) / ordinary_native_2q_mean; negative means fewer instructions
metrics.best_sample_gap_percent: Reported min/max across seeds of 100 * (best_sample_energy - classical_minimum) / abs(classical_minimum); 0 is best
metrics.missing_gap: null means that no scored gap was supplied for that size

figure.selection_reason: Selected sizes simplify the README comparison; all reported sizes for these metrics remain in rows and the research note

limits: Aggregated owner-reported results; raw records, circuits, and experiment implementation are not included.
Gate changes derived from rounded mean counts are not the mean of per-seed percentage changes.
Score-gap intervals are observed ranges across three seeds, not uncertainty or confidence intervals.
A gap in synthetic objective score is not a mission success rate, vulnerability severity, or bounty outcome.
No scored energy gap is supplied above 20 candidates; larger-size answer quality is not established here.
The 32-candidate case has two seeds and the 40-candidate case one; neither establishes a general scaling law.
This circuit used fixed, untuned parameters; the results do not apply to every QAOA configuration.
A lower native gate count does not by itself establish better answers, lower wall time, or lower monetary cost.
The October simulator sweep is separate from the September 6 IBM Fez hardware pilot.
Automatic backend routing and compiler selection are design recommendations, not deployment receipts.
No quantum computational advantage or independent confirmation is established.
